names: Starch acetate esterified with vinyl acetate (stabiliser)
display_name: E1421 (Starch acetate esterified with vinyl acetate)

more_info.overview: This legacy entry describes starch acetate made using vinyl acetate as the acetylating reagent. Acetyl groups are introduced into the starch rather than the ingredient being a mixture of untreated starch and vinyl acetate. FDA's modified-food-starch regulation identifies vinyl-acetate esterification and limits the resulting acetyl-group content. The specific modification distinguishes the preparation from phosphate-crosslinked and hydroxypropylated starches. Current food examples under this historical designation were not confirmed.
more_info.origin: Chemically modified starch made by acetylation with vinyl acetate. The manufacturing reagent and final starch derivative are different substances.
